notes.title: New Steam Rewards Available: Play to Unlock!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, gamers!

We’re excited to announce that new Steam community items are now live! Collect special trading cards, personalize your profile with stunning backgrounds, and add some fun with new emoticons and avatar frames.

Play the game, enjoy, and start earning these fantastic rewards. We appreciate your continued support!

Best regards,
Play & Cum 💦 Team
[/h3]

notes.title: Trip starts soon - get ready! 🚗
notes.content:
[h3]Lately we've been working on a new project, focusing on your feedback and trying to overdo ourselves, and we're almost ready to release it! 

At the end of this week you'll get a chance to get free from your excessively protective and overbearing mother and go on an adventure of a lifetime - jump into the fresh&shiny car that your dad gifted you and set out on a wild trip across the country. 

Explore the world, yourself, hot girls and their bodies - fluid animations, beautiful chicks, fun-to-read story and lots of adult scenes are coming!

Make sure to wishlist the game - this way you won't miss a little surprise we're preparing for the most attentive fans! 

We're eager to see you playing and exploring SEX Route 69! 📍[/h3]
